reviews.title: Has promise but missing core items
reviews.text: I reallly like this alarm app however it is missing a core feature for us sleepyheads. I need the ability to simply set multiple alarms that are not tied into a schedule that you have to change. IE allow me to set an 0800 alarm and then 0900 & 1000 etc. People like myself  with real sleep issues, which this app is aimed at need this ability. This is in fact what I thought I was purchasing when I bought the lifetime pro version. Please make this happen so I can use this app again.

reviews.title: Great Potential, Annoying Bugs
reviews.text: I really appreciate using this app for wake-up alarms, because it actually forces me to get up. I also like that it’s built with AlarmKit and works just like a normal alarm in iOS without having to do any weird workarounds. However, the snooze button randomly stops working sometimes, and will just send me directly to the mission screen instead of snoozing the alarm for the specified duration. Also, I linked it with the Structured app to see my tasks in my morning briefing, and that never worked, which prevented me from considering using Structured at all. I am paying for Awake Pro, and really want to like this app, but it’s still a little rough in its current state.

reviews.title: Really great app! But, one question.
reviews.text:
This app is awesome! I’ve been subscribed to Structured Pro (their other app) for years now so when Awake came out, I had to try it. Even the simpler alarms are annoying enough to wake me up (that’s their job), and the weather report in my morning briefing is very useful. Also, people need to notice their impeccable customer service! Almost every review here is followed by a developer response. They are actually listening to us! This app and Structured are the perfect duo for productivity.

But I have been wondering: in my morning briefing, there is a widget to rate how well you slept. Every morning, however, it says “Sleep Data Unavailable”. I’m not sure why. 

Small bug aside, this is surely a five star rating. The app is a great idea executed well and it is worth paying for!

reviews.title: It’s great
reviews.text:
This app is fantastic! I truly appreciate the morning briefing and all the connectivity options it offers. I find it particularly useful for struggling to get out of bed. 

However, I’ve encountered an issue with my sporadic sleep schedule. 

My job demands that I wake up and go to sleep at any time of the day, which makes it challenging to adhere to the app’s preset schedule. 

It would be great if the app allowed me to break free from this schedule and set individual daily alarms. 

I believe many truck drivers would agree with this request.

reviews.title: Good app I wouldn’t pay for it.
reviews.text:
I purchased this app because I really enjoyed the free version. I work a lot and don’t get much sleep, so I need something that actually helps me wake up and stay on track. I’ve also been trying to build new habits, and mornings are the hardest time to stay consistent. This app has been really helpful in getting me up and prepared for the day.

However, after purchasing, I expected more flexibility. For example, I thought I’d be able to set alarms for things like a two-hour nap during the day, but it seems limited to set schedules only.

Also, since I already use the Structure app, I would love to see better integration between the two, especially being able to connect wake-up and sleep times across both apps.

reviews.title: Deleted twice!!!
reviews.text:
I tried this out bc I wasn’t totally happy with Alarmy, but realized pretty quickly that Awake doesn’t support all the types of wake up tasks I like, so I deleted it. I did not bother to delete the alarm I had previously set up in the app, because I assumed (REASONABLY) that it would go away when the app did.

Then this morning I get an alarm that I CANNOT shut off. It WILL NOT go away. I couldn’t figure out why, or where it was even coming from, until I finally noticed there was a little thing saying “awake.io.” 

After several minutes of desperation, I reinstalled the app, which opened in its fresh state with no alarms set, and lo and behold the phantom alarm stopped. 

I don’t know HOW they have it set up, but something ain’t right. That’s malware behavior. Apps shouldn’t persist on your device once you’ve deleted them.

reviews.title: Don’t Spend the Money
reviews.text:
I recently downloaded the app “structured” from this brand and liked it, so when it suggested I also use their app “awake” I jumped right on it and paid for a year subscription. 

In theory this app is a great idea…if only it worked. Nine times out of ten I have issues with the morning alarm. Most of the time it’s an issue with the mission/puzzle not popping up and then the alarm will just keep going off again and again because you HAVE to complete the mission for the alarm to stop. Other times I complete the mission and the “I’m awake” button won’t register that I’m clicking it. So again, the alarm won’t stop going off. I’ve also had days where the alarm didn’t even go off at all. Thankfully I work from home so it wasn’t a huge issue for me, but that is not something you want in a morning alarm…… don’t waste your money.
